language: English source; coach translates at runtime
principles: Listen before asking: do not ask a question when the opening message already supports a signal value with enough confidence.
Ask in natural language; answerKinds are classifier guidance, not mandatory UI cards.
The means field is the semantic contract for interpreting free-text answers.
Do not force a value when the answer does not support one. Use unknown where the signal allows it, or ask one high-information follow-up.
Stop when enough signals exist to change Goal-Family routing and Journey selection.

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: How clear are you about the direction or kind of role you are aiming for right now?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: The opening message does not already make direction clarity obvious.

unclear.means: The person cannot name one coherent direction or role family, names several materially different possibilities, or says the main task is figuring out what they want next.

cardCopy.en: I’m still figuring out what direction fits me
cardCopy.he: אני עדיין מנסה להבין לאן נכון לי לכוון

partial.means: The person has one or two plausible directions but is still comparing, testing, or unable to choose between them.

cardCopy.en: I have a couple of directions I’m considering
cardCopy.he: יש לי כמה כיוונים על הפרק

clear.means: The person can name one reasonably coherent direction or role family and describe the kind of work they are trying to move toward.

cardCopy.en: I have a fairly clear direction in mind
cardCopy.he: יש לי כיוון די ברור

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: Are you already actively looking or applying for work, or are you still deciding and preparing?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: The opening message does not already show whether an active search is underway.

yes.means: The person is currently applying, reaching out, interviewing, or otherwise pursuing external roles now.

cardCopy.en: I’m already in an active job search
cardCopy.he: אני כבר בתוך חיפוש עבודה פעיל

no.means: The person is still choosing a direction, preparing, building readiness, or thinking about a future move without an active search yet.

cardCopy.en: I’m still deciding or preparing
cardCopy.he: אני עדיין בשלב של החלטה או הכנה

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: What kinds of roles are you applying for right now?

broad.means: Applications span materially different role families, the target changes from posting to posting, or the person cannot describe one reasonably coherent target.

cardCopy.en: My search spans several different kinds of roles
cardCopy.he: החיפוש שלי מתפרס על כמה סוגי תפקידים שונים

clear.means: Most current applications belong to one reasonably defined role family and the person can explain what that target is.

cardCopy.en: Most of my search is focused on one kind of role
cardCopy.he: רוב החיפוש שלי ממוקד בסוג תפקיד אחד

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: Looking at the work you want to do next, what have you already done that is genuinely similar?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: A target direction or role is clear enough to compare against.

yes.means: The person can point to at least one concrete example from work, a project, volunteering, study, or an adjacent role where they performed a meaningful part of the target work.

cardCopy.en: I’ve already done work that is genuinely similar
cardCopy.he: כבר עשיתי עבודה שבאמת דומה למה שאני רוצה לעשות

no.means: The person cannot point to a real example of doing the core target work yet; the gap is likely capability or first exposure rather than presentation alone.

cardCopy.en: I haven’t really done that kind of work yet
cardCopy.he: עוד לא באמת עשיתי עבודה מהסוג הזה

unknown.means: The answer is too vague to tell whether the experience is actually relevant, or the person is unsure what the target work requires.

cardCopy.en: I’m not sure what in my experience is actually relevant
cardCopy.he: לא ברור לי מה מתוך הניסיון שלי באמת רלוונטי

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: When you do have relevant experience, how easy is it to show that with a concrete example someone else could understand?

yes.means: The person says they can do the work but their CV/profile only lists responsibilities, their strongest examples are hard to explain or inaccessible, or they struggle to make the evidence credible to someone who was not there.

cardCopy.en: I can do it, but it’s hard to show with clear examples
cardCopy.he: יש לי יכולת, אבל קשה לי להראות אותה בדוגמאות ברורות

no.means: The person already has concrete, understandable examples or artifacts that make the relevant ability visible to an outsider.

cardCopy.en: I have clear examples that show I can do it
cardCopy.he: יש לי דוגמאות ברורות שמראות את היכולת שלי

unknown.means: There is not enough detail yet to judge whether the problem is missing proof or something else.

cardCopy.en: I’m not sure how convincing my examples are
cardCopy.he: לא ברור לי עד כמה הדוגמאות שלי באמת משכנעות

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: How much access do you have to people in the field or to real conversations around the opportunities you want?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: The route may depend on opportunity/access rather than target or proof.

yes.means: The person can name relevant people, communities, former colleagues, warm connections, or realistic channels through which a real conversation or introduction can happen.

cardCopy.en: I have people or channels I can realistically reach
cardCopy.he: יש לי אנשים או ערוצים שבאמת אפשר להגיע דרכם להזדמנויות

no.means: The search depends almost entirely on anonymous applications or passive browsing, and the person cannot currently name realistic people or channels they can reach.

cardCopy.en: Most of my search relies on open applications
cardCopy.he: רוב החיפוש שלי נשען על הגשות פתוחות

unknown.means: The person has not tried to use people/channels yet or cannot tell what access is realistically available.

cardCopy.en: I haven’t really tested this route yet
cardCopy.he: עוד לא באמת בדקתי את הערוץ הזה

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: Have you had a recent interview for the kind of role you are trying to get?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: The user reports interview difficulty or the coach needs evidence about the interview stage.

yes.means: There is a recent, target-relevant interview the person can still reconstruct well enough to learn from.

cardCopy.en: I’ve had a relevant interview recently
cardCopy.he: היה לי לאחרונה ראיון רלוונטי

no.means: There has not been a recent interview for the current target, or the available interview is too old or too different to be useful evidence.

cardCopy.en: I haven’t had a relevant interview recently
cardCopy.he: לא היה לי ראיון רלוונטי לאחרונה

unknown.means: It is unclear whether the interview was recent or relevant enough to the current target.

cardCopy.en: I’m not sure my last interview is relevant enough
cardCopy.he: לא ברור לי אם הראיון האחרון מספיק רלוונטי

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: Have you done enough focused searching with the same target to see a real pattern yet?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: The coach is tempted to diagnose a search failure from a small or mixed sample.

yes.means: There have been several comparable attempts with a reasonably stable target and process, enough that the same failure point has repeated and is not just one isolated outcome.

cardCopy.en: I’ve done enough similar searching to see a pattern
cardCopy.he: עשיתי מספיק חיפוש דומה כדי לראות דפוס

no.means: There are too few attempts, the target has changed too much, or the search actions are too different to support a reliable diagnosis yet.

cardCopy.en: Not yet — there have been too few or too different attempts
cardCopy.he: עוד לא — היו מעט מדי ניסיונות או שהם היו שונים מדי

unknown.means: The person cannot reconstruct enough of the recent search to tell whether a stable pattern exists.

cardCopy.en: I can’t really tell from what I’ve done so far
cardCopy.he: קשה לי לדעת ממה שעשיתי עד עכשיו

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: After what you have tried, does this still feel like something you genuinely want to pursue?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: Persistence, repeated rejection, or a stalled transition is becoming the main issue.

yes.means: The person still wants the outcome for reasons that matter to them, even if the current tactic or pace needs to change.

cardCopy.en: Yes — this is still something I genuinely want
cardCopy.he: כן — זה עדיין משהו שאני באמת רוצה

no.means: The person is mainly continuing because of sunk cost, external pressure, identity, or fear of stopping, and would not clearly choose the target again now.

cardCopy.en: Not really — I’m mostly continuing because I’ve already invested in it
cardCopy.he: לא ממש — בעיקר קשה לי לשחרר אחרי שכבר השקעתי בזה

unknown.means: The answer is genuinely ambivalent or the person cannot separate desire for the goal from pressure around it.

cardCopy.en: I’m genuinely not sure anymore
cardCopy.he: לא ברור לי כרגע אם זה עדיין באמת חשוב לי

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: How much time and energy can you realistically protect for this in a normal week?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: The opening message and onboarding do not already answer it.

very_light.means: The person can reliably offer only very short bursts and cannot protect a full hour most weeks.

cardCopy.en: Only short bursts — less than an hour most weeks
cardCopy.he: רק פרקי זמן קצרים — פחות משעה ברוב השבועות

light.means: The person can usually protect up to about one hour per week.

cardCopy.en: About an hour a week
cardCopy.he: בערך שעה בשבוע

moderate.means: The person can usually protect about one to three hours per week.

cardCopy.en: About 1–3 hours a week
cardCopy.he: בערך 1–3 שעות בשבוע

substantial.means: The person can usually protect more than three hours per week.

cardCopy.en: More than 3 hours a week
cardCopy.he: יותר מ־3 שעות בשבוע

variable.means: Capacity swings enough from week to week that one stable weekly number would be misleading.

cardCopy.en: It changes a lot from week to week
cardCopy.he: זה משתנה מאוד משבוע לשבוע

coreDiagnosisQuestions.question: For this goal, would involving other people make it easier to move, or would it mostly add friction?
coreDiagnosisQuestions.askWhen: A Journey may rely on conversations, feedback, community, accountability, or another person's involvement.

helpful.means: The person generally finds that the right other person makes action easier, clearer, or more likely to happen.

cardCopy.en: The right person usually helps me move
cardCopy.he: מעורבות של האדם הנכון בדרך כלל עוזרת לי להתקדם

neutral.means: Other people are acceptable but are not an important source of momentum or friction.

cardCopy.en: It usually doesn’t make much difference
cardCopy.he: בדרך כלל זה לא משנה לי הרבה

friction.means: Coordination, exposure, asking for help, or being observed tends to make the person delay, avoid, or disengage from this goal.

cardCopy.en: Involving other people usually makes it harder
cardCopy.he: מעורבות של אנשים אחרים בדרך כלל מקשה עליי

depends.means: Whether people help depends strongly on who is involved or on the type of interaction.

cardCopy.en: It really depends on who is involved and how
cardCopy.he: זה מאוד תלוי במי מעורב ובאיזו דרך

conditionalRoutingQuestions.question: What kind of transition are you actually making: a new field or function, a new industry in the same kind of work, a new function in the same industry, returning after a break, or planning an exit?

new_field_or_function.means: The target changes the core professional field or function.

cardCopy.en: I want to move into a different field or function
cardCopy.he: אני רוצה לעבור לתחום או לפונקציה אחרת

new_industry_same_function.means: The person wants essentially the same kind of work in a different industry.

cardCopy.en: The same kind of work, in a different industry
cardCopy.he: אותו סוג עבודה, בתעשייה אחרת

new_function_same_industry.means: The industry stays roughly the same but the function/role changes.

cardCopy.en: A different kind of role, in the same industry
cardCopy.he: סוג תפקיד אחר, באותה תעשייה

reentry.means: The person is returning to the labor market after a meaningful break.

cardCopy.en: My goal is to return to work after a break
cardCopy.he: המטרה שלי היא לחזור לשוק העבודה אחרי הפסקה

planned_exit.means: The immediate goal is to leave the current role in a staged, non-panic way before or while deciding the next move.

cardCopy.en: I want to leave my current role in a planned way
cardCopy.he: אני רוצה לצאת מהתפקיד הנוכחי בצורה מסודרת

conditionalRoutingQuestions.question: What is the main bridge missing right now: ability to do the work, proof that you can do it, access to the right people or opportunities, clarity about the direction, or a life constraint that has to be respected first?

capability.means: The person genuinely cannot yet perform enough of the target work at a usable baseline.

cardCopy.en: I still need to build some of the ability the move requires
cardCopy.he: עדיין חסרה לי חלק מהיכולת שהמעבר דורש

proof.means: The person can do relevant work but cannot yet make that ability visible or credible to the target market.

cardCopy.en: I can do relevant work, but I need stronger evidence of it
cardCopy.he: יש לי יכולת רלוונטית, אבל חסרות לי הוכחות ברורות

access.means: The target and ability are plausible, but the person lacks realistic channels to people, opportunities, or exposure.

cardCopy.en: The direction makes sense, but I’m not reaching the right people or opportunities
cardCopy.he: הכיוון הגיוני, אבל אני לא מגיע לאנשים או להזדמנויות הנכונים

direction.means: The person is not yet clear enough on which transition target to build toward.

cardCopy.en: I’m still not clear enough on the transition target
cardCopy.he: עדיין לא ברור לי מספיק לאיזה יעד במעבר אני מכוון

context_constraint.means: Time, money, caregiving, health, geography, legal/work status, or another real-world constraint currently determines feasibility more than content does.

cardCopy.en: A real-life constraint is shaping what is possible right now
cardCopy.he: אילוץ אמיתי בחיים כרגע קובע מה אפשרי

conditionalRoutingQuestions.question: Is there a specific next level, role, or promotion you are aiming for, or do you mainly want more growth in your current role?

yes.means: The person can name a concrete next level/role/promotion target that exists in their context.

cardCopy.en: I’m aiming for a specific next level or role
cardCopy.he: אני מכוון לרמה או לתפקיד הבא באופן די ברור

no.means: The person wants growth, learning, or more responsibility but is not pursuing one specific next level.

cardCopy.en: I mainly want to grow where I am
cardCopy.he: אני בעיקר רוצה לגדול בתוך התפקיד הנוכחי

unknown.means: The person suspects a next step exists but cannot yet define it clearly enough to route as a concrete promotion target.

cardCopy.en: I think there is a next step, but it isn’t clear yet
cardCopy.he: נראה שיש צעד הבא, אבל הוא עדיין לא ברור

conditionalRoutingQuestions.question: What is actually blocking growth where you are now: not enough responsibility, a capability you still need, not enough visibility or access, or a limit in the role or workplace itself?

responsibility_scope.means: The person is capable of more but their current scope does not give them enough ownership or stretch.

cardCopy.en: What I’m missing is more responsibility or scope
cardCopy.he: מה שחסר לי הוא יותר אחריות או היקף

capability.means: A real skill/capability gap prevents the next level of work.

cardCopy.en: I need to build a capability before the next step
cardCopy.he: חסרה לי יכולת שצריך לבנות לפני הצעד הבא

access_visibility.means: The ability may exist, but the person lacks visibility, sponsorship, stakeholder access, or an opportunity to demonstrate it.

cardCopy.en: I can probably do more, but I’m not getting the visibility or opportunity
cardCopy.he: כנראה יש לי יכולת ליותר, אבל חסרה לי נראות או הזדמנות

context_constraint.means: The workplace or role itself does not offer a realistic path for the desired growth.

cardCopy.en: The role or workplace itself limits the growth I want
cardCopy.he: התפקיד או מקום העבודה עצמם מגבילים את הצמיחה שאני רוצה

conditionalRoutingQuestions.question: If the main problem is fit in your current role, what would most improve it: the mix of work you do, how you work with people, or how much learning and growth the role gives you?

task_mix.means: The main mismatch is the type or proportion of tasks and responsibilities.

cardCopy.en: The work itself and the mix of tasks
cardCopy.he: העבודה עצמה ותמהיל המשימות

collaboration.means: The main mismatch is how the person works with colleagues, manager, stakeholders, or team interfaces.

cardCopy.en: How the work happens with the people around me
cardCopy.he: איך העבודה מתנהלת מול האנשים סביבי

learning_growth.means: The work is tolerable but feels stagnant because there is too little learning, stretch, or development.

cardCopy.en: How much learning and growth the role gives me
cardCopy.he: רמת הלמידה והצמיחה שיש לי בתפקיד

context_constraint.means: The problem is not realistically changeable through task, collaboration, or growth redesign inside the current context.

cardCopy.en: The role or workplace cannot realistically change enough
cardCopy.he: התפקיד או מקום העבודה לא באמת ניתנים לשינוי מספיק

nonSignalPlanningPrompts.question: What would count as a real change here — something we could recognize in the world, not only feel?
nonSignalPlanningPrompts.note: Planning/personalization prompt, not a fixed routing signal.

nonSignalPlanningPrompts.question: What have you already tried around this, and what happened?
nonSignalPlanningPrompts.note: Free-text evidence used to avoid repeating a failed tactic and to choose follow-ups; do not coerce it into one fixed signal.

nonSignalPlanningPrompts.question: What does this plan have to respect to be realistic in your life right now?
nonSignalPlanningPrompts.note: Store as free-text constraints and feasibility context. Domain-specific signals may be emitted when the answer clearly matches one.

changesFrom1.2: Every answerKinds key now equals its contract value.
Previous readable kind names are retained only as legacyKind metadata where they differed.
Every fixed answer value now has approved English and Hebrew user-facing card copy.
